cohort: The study included 2024 middle-aged women aged 40-60 years old from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey.
finding: The study found no significant associations between parity and CVD risk factors after controlling for covariates, but CVD risk factors significantly increased with higher BMI levels, regardless of parity status.
cross-section timing: Data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2007-2012
